author: ahshum
content:
<@&1417820113981145228> Bumping up. The problem we found is that during backfill, envelope built by exited builder is not able to be verified as missing of state of that time, so the builder's pubkey is not available.

Does anyone have any ideas or suggestions for solving this question? It seems like there would need a certain level of spec changes.

author: etan_status
content:
an idea/suggestion, as a summary from https://github.com/status-im/nimbus-eth2/pull/9334#discussion_r4358131868

> does the STF check the signature? 
> - if no, then change the proto so that the sig should always be zero (or infinity) when serving req/resp for envelopes
> - if yes, then just include a Merkle proof of the signing pubkey relative to the state_root in the response together with the historical envelope. And then on verifier check that it sits at the correct builder_index/validator_index in the corresponding beaconblock's state_root

would need simple change to p2p-protocol spec (and in the 'yes' case, also collecting additional stuff in DB)

author: 0xunclebill
content:
we skip  signature verification for builders during envelope backfill instead we recompute the block hash of the envelope and compare it to the block_hash in the bid

i dont think the signature adds any additional security
